subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “At first, the answers were short.”?
options: Later, students used the same idea in other situations.
Later, the students watched people drink the soup and smile.

本文沒有陳述「Later, students wrote more carefully.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
